purpose: Separate non-authoritative detection/monitoring signals from single-writer authoritative task state and make signal consumption verify-first rather than clarification-first.

consumption.required_action: Re-observe evidence first. Resolve retrievable facts autonomously. Ask the user only for unavailable facts or genuine human judgment. If actionable, construct a stable Agent-ready brief before delegation; otherwise close or retain the signal with reason.

agent_ready_brief.principle: A downstream Agent receives stable behavior/state/interfaces/evidence and testable acceptance criteria, not a noisy transcript or stale line-number/file-layout micromanagement.

assurance_boundary: A signal proves only that an observation was reported. Work-admission classification proves only deterministic process state, not that the diagnosis is semantically correct. Neither is a lease, a business state transition, nor live quality proof.
